YOUR LOCAL LOCKSMITH

Gate welding & repairs

Ask about welding repairs to metal gates. Send a photo of the damaged hinge, joint or gate and describe the access available for the work.

Call 0203 7720564Send an enquiry

Show us the damaged area

A wider photo of the gate and a close view of the affected joint or hinge help explain the repair. Describe whether the gate is sagging, will not close or has a visibly broken part.

Keep an unsafe gate clear

Avoid using a gate that may fall or a hinge that is coming away. Keep people clear of the affected area and explain any access restrictions when enquiring.

Checking repair options

The condition of the surrounding metal matters as well as the damaged joint. Suitability for welding and any further work are assessed before the repair is agreed.
